title: Consider a tab bar before a sidebar in iOS and iPadOS

statement.en: Consider using a tab bar first in iOS or iPadOS.
statement.ja: iOSまたはiPadOSでは、まずtab barの使用を検討する。

conditions: A tab bar leaves more room for content and can navigate among many apps' main areas.
Use the convertible sidebar appearance when additional, less-frequent areas exceed tab-bar capacity.
